correctness.rationale: For finite product of fields R=∏F_qi, r>=2, the graph with nonzero zero divisors and units has bipartite incidence rows f_z(u)=1−∏_{i in supp(z)}[1−1_{u_i=−z_i}]. The Gram H^T H is invariant under unit-group coordinate multiplication and is diagonal in multiplicative characters. For character nontrivial support T!=empty, squared Fourier-row sums yield lambda_T=∏_{i∉T}[(q_i−1)+(q_i−2)^2]−∏_{i∉T}(q_i−2)^2; the constant character requires explicit exclusion of empty/full support and has MQ−3M²+2MB+C−B². Exactly the full-coordinate character has eigenvalue zero, multiplicity B=∏(q_i−2); all proper-support eigenvalues are positive. Rank(H)=M−B, full graph adjacency spectrum has signed sqrt(lambda_T) with character multiplicities ∏_{i∈T}(q_i−2), nullity Q−1−2(M−B). Nonprime fields require only multiplicative characters and negation bijection. Independently formed integer incidence Gram characteristic polynomials in 8 small parameter tuples and matched the complete formula; general result rests on harmonic proof.
